articles.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 gets a model painter demo, so you can make a mess of your Orks, Necrons, Space Marines and AdMech before they even hit the battlefield
articles.summary: In the grim darkness of the week before the release of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 , developers King Art and publishers Deep Silver have released a demo model painter. It's your chance to pre-emptively run a brush over units from the new strategy game's four major factions – Orks, Adeptus Mechanicus, Necrons and Space Marines. The Imperial Guard are in the game too, but mostly as a tutorial army. What a slap in the face for the Imperium's vanilla humans. Deep Silver are calling it "the most powerful Painter in Dawn of War history", which doesn't seem all that dashing a boast given that Dawn of War 3 came out almost 10 years ago and today's PCs have a fair bit more RAM in them. You can opt for Basic Painter mode in order to quickly knock together livery for entire armies, or fire up the Advanced Painter and get stuck into the weeds of individual armour and body parts, with a choice of materials, patterns, decals and weathering.
